response.overview: The main characters are young people, a boy and a girl. Today’s schoolchildren. Residents of a provincial town. Every morning, at the same bus stop, they would board the same bus, without noticing each other. And then one day… He suddenly saw Her — vulnerable, weak, unable to fight for herself, for her happiness. And she saw Him — open, fearlessly facing everything that life would offer. They experienced what we most desire, but also fear most: love. And not just any love, but first love. The kind that comes once in a lifetime. Fate gave them only three days and four meetings. But that was enough to change their world—and themselves—forever.
response.tagline: Wherever we need to be, we will never be late.
response.title: Остановка
